newsitem.title: USA: Wolverine Tube completes note tender.
newsitem.headline: Wolverine Tube completes note tender.

text.p: Wolverine Tube Inc said Monday it had successfully completed a tender offer and consent solicitation for $99 million in outstanding principal amount of its 10-1/8 percent senior subordinated notes due 2002.
The company said it accepted all validly tendered notes for payment pursuant to the offer, which expired April 25. Payment is set for April 30, the company said.
As of April 25, some $98,225,000 in principal amount of the notes had been tendered and not withdrawn.
Noteholders will receive $1,065.99 per $1,000 principal, which includes accrued and unpaid interest.
Noteholders who consented to the proposed amendments to the indenture will receive a consent payment of $1.00 per $1,000 principal.
